shortDescription: Add or remove Pulp repos from a remote host

options.name: add_export_distributor
options.description: Whether or not to add the export distributor to new C(rpm) repositories.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication. This file can also include the key as well, and if the key is included, O(client_key) is not required.

options.name: client_key
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication. If O(client_cert) contains both the certificate and key, this option is not required.

options.name: feed
options.description: Upstream feed URL to receive updates from.

options.name: feed_ca_cert
options.description: CA certificate string used to validate the feed source SSL certificate. This can be the file content or the path to the file.

options.name: feed_client_cert
options.description: Certificate used as the client certificate when synchronizing the repository. This is used to communicate authentication information to the feed source. The value to this option must be the full path to the certificate. The specified file may be the certificate itself or a single file containing both the certificate and private key. This can be the file content or the path to the file.

options.name: feed_client_key
options.description: Private key to the certificate specified in O(feed_client_cert), assuming it is not included in the certificate file itself. This can be the file content or the path to the file.

options.name: force
options.description: If V(yes) do not get a cached copy.

options.name: force_basic_auth
options.description: C(httplib2), the library used by the M(ansible.builtin.uri) module only sends authentication information when a webservice responds to an initial request with a 401 status. Since some basic auth services do not properly send a 401, logins fail. This option forces the sending of the Basic authentication header upon initial request.

options.name: generate_sqlite
options.description: Boolean flag to indicate whether sqlite files should be generated during a repository publish.

options.name: http_agent
options.description: Header to identify as, generally appears in web server logs.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the repo to add or remove. This correlates to repo-id in Pulp.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: Proxy URL setting for the pulp repository importer. This is in the format V(scheme://host).

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: Proxy password for the pulp repository importer.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: Proxy port setting for the pulp repository importer.

options.name: proxy_username
options.description: Proxy username for the pulp repository importer.

options.name: publish_distributor
options.description: Distributor to use when O(state=publish). The default is to publish all distributors.

options.name: pulp_host
options.description: URL of the pulp server to connect to.

options.name: relative_url
options.description: Relative URL for the local repository. It's required when state=present.

options.name: repo_type
options.description: Repo plugin type to use (that is, V(rpm), V(docker)).

options.name: repoview
options.description: Whether to generate repoview files for a published repository. Setting this to V(true) automatically activates O(generate_sqlite).

options.name: serve_http
options.description: Make the repo available over HTTP.

options.name: serve_https
options.description: Make the repo available over HTTPS.

options.name: state
options.description: The repo state. A state of V(sync) queues a sync of the repo. This is asynchronous but not delayed like a scheduled sync. A state of V(publish) uses the repository's distributor to publish the content.

options.name: url
options.description: HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP URL in the form (http|https|ftp)://[user[:pass]]@host.domain[:port]/path

options.name: url_password
options.description: The password for use in HTTP basic authentication to the pulp API. If the O(url_username) parameter is not specified, the O(url_password) parameter is not used.

options.name: url_username
options.description: The username for use in HTTP basic authentication to the pulp API.

options.name: use_gssapi
options.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library L(gssapi,https://github.com/pythongssapi/python-gssapi) to be installed. Credentials for GSSAPI can be specified with O(url_username)/O(url_password) or with the GSSAPI env var E(KRB5CCNAME) that specified a custom Kerberos credential cache. NTLM authentication is B(not) supported even if the GSSAPI mech for NTLM has been installed.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If V(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: wait_for_completion
options.description: Wait for asynchronous tasks to complete before returning.
